description:
Fantom Corporation is a mission-focused organization supporting critical programs across the defense and intelligence community. We partner with our customers to deliver high-impact technical solutions while fostering a culture built on trust, expertise, and long-term career growth.
We are seeking an AI Engineer to build and deploy scalable, production-ready artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI capabilities. This role develops models, data pipelines, and microservices supporting large language model (LLM) applications, agentic workflows, and advanced analytics.
You will support an in-house custom application, integrating AI services, retrieval systems, databases, and application components across secure operational environments. The position combines hands-on engineering with technical mentorship and collaboration to improve performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
Education: Bachelor’s degree required
Experience: Minimum of 10 years of specialized AI/ML engineering experience
Must possess an active Top Secret Clearance
Must be willing and able to obtain a polygraph

Key Responsibilities
 

 
 Build production-ready AI/ML and generative AI models, pipelines, and microservices.



 
 Develop training, evaluation, and inference pipelines in Python using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.



 
 Deploy and manage models using MLOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and monitoring frameworks.



 
 Implement embeddings, vector databases, LLM applications, agentic AI, and tool-calling workflows.



 
 Develop multi-model and multimodal capabilities spanning reasoning, perception, memory, and tool execution.



 
 Implement temporal, spatial, geographic, quantitative, and computer vision AI capabilities.



 
 Develop named entity recognition, contextual entity extraction, and entity resolution workflows.



 
 Build multi-step retrieval and structured output generation with source citations and traceable analytical outputs.



 
 Create and optimize parsing, ingestion, normalization, and ETL pipelines for structured and unstructured data.



 
 Integrate vector, graph, and relational databases while supporting attribute-based access control, data provenance, and end-to-end lineage.



 
 Optimize model accuracy, response latency, operating costs, and scalability across distributed environments.



 
 Integrate user interfaces, backend services, middleware, databases, and AI components within the custom application.



 
 Support air-gapped, hybrid, and on-premises deployments, including locally hosted GPU servers and hyperconverged infrastructure.



 
 Maintain documentation and align development with AI governance, ethical requirements, and security standards.



 
 Mentor engineers and promote consistent engineering practices across teams.






Required Qualifications
 

 Bachelor’s degree.

 
 Minimum of 10 years of specialized AI/ML engineering experience.



 
 Advanced Python skills and a strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and distributed systems.



 
 Hands-on experience deploying production generative AI and LLM systems, embeddings, and vector databases.



 
 Proficiency with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn.



 
 Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.



 
 Practical experience with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Azure Machine Learning, or Vertex AI.



 
 Background in natural language processing, computer vision, or reinforcement learning.



 
 Experience working in Agile engineering environments.



 
 Experience with multi-model and multimodal orchestration, multi-step retrieval, and structured output generation.



 
 Experience with named entity recognition, contextual entity extraction, and entity resolution.



 
 Experience building automated ETL pipelines and normalizing diverse structured and unstructured data.



 
 Experience integrating vector, graph, and relational databases.



 
 Knowledge of attribute-based access control, data provenance, and data lineage.



 
 Experience supporting air-gapped, hybrid, and on-premises environments.



 
 Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, locally hosted GPU servers, and hyperconverged nodes.



 
 Experience with multitenant cross-domain solutions.



 
 Application development and integration experience using TypeScript, React, Python, and FastAPI.



 
 Experience with LanceDB, Lance Graph, PostgreSQL, and Temporal.io.



 
 Ability to integrate reasoning components, retrieval systems, databases, and AI services into a custom application.






Preferred Qualifications

 
 Experience supporting federal, defense, or highly regulated environments.



 
 Knowledge of ethical AI, governance frameworks, and secure development practices.



 
 Experience with large-scale optimization, GPU acceleration, or distributed training.



 
 Experience building APIs, microservices, and automated machine learning workflows.




 #CJ

 
Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Software Development, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements. 
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
